categories.main_business_segments: Kurita Water Industries operates two main business segments: the 'Electronics Market,' which provides water treatment equipment, chemicals, maintenance, and precision cleaning services primarily for the electronics and semiconductor industries; and the 'General Water Treatment Market,' which offers water treatment equipment, chemicals, maintenance, soil and groundwater remediation, and environmental analysis services to a broad range of industrial and municipal customers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced water treatment technologies, including ultrapure water production systems, membrane filtration (RO), chemical dosing, and precision cleaning. It emphasizes digital transformation through the development of sensing, data analytics, and optimal control technologies, as well as mathematical modeling of water treatment processes and material informatics for efficient R&D.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Kurita serves electronics manufacturers (notably semiconductor and display fabs), general industrial companies (such as chemicals, paper, steel, and food), and public sector clients. The electronics segment is focused on high-tech industries requiring ultrapure water, while the general segment covers a wide range of manufacturing and infrastructure sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: Kurita operates globally with key regions including Japan, Asia (notably China, Korea, Taiwan, Southeast Asia), North and South America (especially the US and Brazil), and EMEA (Europe, Middle East, Africa, with significant presence in Germany and other European countries). Overseas sales account for over half of total revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: Kurita is positioned downstream in the supply chain, delivering end-to-end water treatment solutions, chemicals, and services directly to industrial and municipal end-users. It also provides ongoing maintenance, operation, and value-added services at customer sites.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding solutions for the electronics industry, accelerating global deployment of CSV (Creating Shared Value) businesses that address sustainability (water saving, GHG reduction, resource recycling), and driving innovation in digital water management and circular economy solutions. R&D focuses on environmental impact reduction, advanced water analytics, and collaborative innovation with external partners.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of water treatment equipment and chemicals, recurring maintenance and operation contracts, precision cleaning services, and long-term service agreements (including ultrapure water supply). The company is shifting toward more recurring, contract-based, and value-added service models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include global water treatment firms such as Ecolab/Nalco, Veolia, SUEZ, and local/regional players. Kurita is positioned as a leading water solutions provider in Asia and is strengthening its global presence, especially in the electronics sector, with a focus on high-value, sustainability-driven offerings.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For FY2025, consolidated revenue reached ¥408.9 billion (approx. $2.7B), with over 8,100 employees. The company has shown steady growth in sales and operating profit, though FY2025 saw a decline in net profit due to impairment losses. The mid-term plan targets ¥470 billion in sales and a 16% business profit margin by FY2027, with a strong emphasis on overseas and service business expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Kurita differentiates itself through integrated, high-value water solutions that combine proprietary technologies, digital innovation, and deep industry expertise. Its unique value lies in its ability to deliver sustainability benefits (water/energy/resource savings, GHG reduction), customized solutions for advanced industries, and a comprehensive service platform that supports customers' operational excellence and environmental goals.
